email_body:
Dear Nestlé recruitment team,

I'd like to apply for the Nescafé Marketing Internship starting February 2027 in Brussels and from home.

I currently work as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto while running my own freelance SEO practice, so I spend my days on the kind of work your team needs: publishing and maintaining CMS content in WordPress, adapting content across pages and channels, writing keyword-led copy, and tracking performance in GA4, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. Running several client sites at once has made me comfortable keeping multiple moving pieces aligned and on schedule, and my technical background means I'm quick with the practical side of artwork and content adaptations.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, can commit to the full six months, and would genuinely enjoy learning the Nescafé brand from the inside. My CV is attached, and I'd welcome the chance to talk.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Nescafé Marketing Internship starting February 2027. I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, working where SEO, content and web meet. I like projects where the work shows up on the page and in the numbers.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites — an e-commerce store, a consultancy — and I publish and update pages, blog posts and media in WordPress with Elementor, Astra and Rank Math. Alongside that I run my own freelance practice building and optimizing sites: baverok.com is mine, and mirook.com needed JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup and repeated technical audits before its search-health score improved. That mix of content, structure and iteration is close to the discipline behind your packaging and launch work: the same message has to hold together across a website, a social post and a product page.

What draws me to this internship is the brand side, plus the chance to work on Belgian campaigns rather than only organic search. My strength sits on execution and analytics — localising content, keeping a site or catalogue current, reading GA4, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to see what actually moved. I'd like to bring that to launch follow-up, artwork adaptations and campaign rollouts for Nescafé, and to learn the CRM and newsletter side from your team.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Brussels, and work from home comfortably. My Dutch is B1 writing and A2+ speaking and I'm improving it; my English is fluent.

I'd be glad to discuss how I could contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cv_highlights:
- Junior Digital Marketer at Episto (2026-present): on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console
- CMS content management in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) - publishing and updating pages, blog posts and media, plus Shopify store design, product catalogue and blog content for harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com
- Freelance SEO, AI search and WordPress: designed, built and optimized baverok.com and mirook.com, including structured data / JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, llms.txt and iterative technical audits that measurably raised search-health scores
- Analytics and platform fluency: Google Analytics GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Ads, backed by Semrush SEO Fundamentals and SEO Toolkit certifications and HubSpot Content Marketing
- Languages: English (fluent), Turkish (native), Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+); based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and available for a 6-month internship from February 2027
